Within the combinatorial methodology of the *Paṭṭhāna*, the text examines conditional relations by cross-permuting the triad of wholesome states (*kusalattika*) with dyads associated with the defiling taints (*āsava*), beginning with the cankers and associated taints dyad (*āsavasāsavaduka*).
